correctness.rationale: For F_a(x)_i=(1-a)(2x_i²−1)+(a/2)(x_{i−1}+x_{i+1}), rotating-wave equation F(x)=Px on three sites is equivalent to a scalar quadratic genuine 3-cycle constrained by the coordinate sum. Reconstructed affine conjugacy to u²+c, dynatomic cubic R_s and sum compatibility: two real branches iff 7a²−14a+1≥0, merging at 1−sqrt(6/7); each has three placements, with fixed points excluded by a nonzero resultant. At a=7/100 the larger-sum wave has three coordinates in (−1,−0.9),(0,0.1),(.7,.8), and an exact moving-frame cubic obeying strict Schur inequalities; the full F³ derivative is B³. Independent numerical reconstruction found the three roots approximately −0.9364366,0.0218005,0.7272768 and moving-frame radius 0.9365083<1. The symbolic discriminant and derivative argument, not numerics, support the continuous-a classification.
